turns.question: Why was no sales tax charged on the Cascade Manufacturing Co invoice CMC-330217?
turns.answer:
No sales tax was charged because Cascade Manufacturing Co applied the resale exemption certificate **OR-EX-88231**, which it noted was on file. The invoice therefore shows **USD 0.00** in sales tax.
